name: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc.

“This was more than another beat-and-raise quarter for ServiceNow, this was the inflection point for ServiceNow as the Super Intelligence Control Tower,” said ServiceNow Chairman and CEO Bill McDermott. “Our customers have validated our strategic relevance as the single harness for enterprise intelligence and security. The Control Tower is the elixir that simplifies tech debt, limits token overload and manages unprecedented cybersecurity risk. That’s why AI adoption is accelerating, surging our hybrid business model to $30 billion in RPO, growing 23 percent. What other company at the forefront of the agentic enterprise has no capital or compute constraints? This is a one-of-one, rule of 571 growth company firing on all cylinders.”

ServiceNow Inc is a provider of cloud-based solutions that define, structure, manage and automate services across the enterprise. Its services include a suite of applications built on proprietary platform.
